title: n8n Workflow Generator
description: Generates complete, importable n8n workflow JSON files plus a companion Polish-language markdown README from a free-text description of a flow's trigger, internal logic, and output. Targets self-hosted n8n 2.13.2+ on the pi-automate stack, with locked typeVersions, placeholder credentials, auto-detected patterns (prompt-vault triad, telegram-with-callbacks, module shape), and pre-write validation.
trigger_description: Use when the user asks for an n8n workflow, automation, flow, or module — including phrases like 'zrób workflow w n8n', 'stwórz flow n8n', 'wygeneruj automatyzację', 'create n8n workflow', or describes a multi-step automation with triggers (schedule/telegram/webhook/module), AI agents, HTTP calls, data transformations, or email/telegram/Sheets/Notion outputs. Trigger even when 'n8n' is not said but the pi-automate context is clear.
author: jarkendar
